mapper.sql: FROM dish d INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id INNER JOIN stall s ON s.id = d.stall_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id LEFT JOIN category cg ON cg.id = d.category_id
WHERE d.status = 'ON_SALE' AND m.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.status = 'OPEN' AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND c.status = 'OPEN'

SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.merchant_id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, d.canteen_id AS canteenId, c.name AS canteenName, d.stall_id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, d.category_id AS categoryId, cg.name AS categoryName, d.name, d.description, d.price, d.average_score AS score, d.taste_score AS tasteScore, d.portion_score AS portionScore, d.value_score AS valueScore, d.view_count AS viewCount, d.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, d.review_count AS commentCount, d.cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, ( SELECT mr.recommend_reason FROM merchant_recommendation mr WHERE mr.dish_id = d.id AND mr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mr.start_time <= NOW() AND mr.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY mr.is_top DESC, mr.start_time DESC, mr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS currentRecommendReason, ( SELECT mr.recommend_type FROM merchant_recommendation mr WHERE mr.dish_id = d.id AND mr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mr.start_time <= NOW() AND mr.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY mr.is_top DESC, mr.start_time DESC, mr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS currentRecommendType, d.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, default_canteen_id AS defaultCanteenId, default_canteen_type AS defaultCanteenType, min_price AS minPrice, max_price AS maxPrice, taste_preference AS tastePreference, avoid_tags AS avoidTags FROM user_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT tag_id AS id, tag_name AS name, SUM(signal_weight) AS weight FROM ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name, 5.0 AS signal_weight FROM favorite f INNER JOIN dish_tag dt ON dt.dish_id = f.target_id INNER JOIN tag t ON t.id = dt.tag_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'DISH' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name, 3.0 AS signal_weight FROM eat_list el INNER JOIN dish_tag dt ON dt.dish_id = el.dish_id INNER JOIN tag t ON t.id = dt.tag_id WHERE el.user_id = #{userId} AND el.status IN ('WANT_TO_EAT', 'EATEN') AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name, 4.0 AS signal_weight FROM review r INNER JOIN dish_tag dt ON dt.dish_id = r.dish_id INNER JOIN tag t ON t.id = dt.tag_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'VISIBLE' AND r.overall_score >= 4.00 AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name, 2.0 AS signal_weight FROM lottery_record lr INNER JOIN dish_tag dt ON dt.dish_id = lr.source_id INNER JOIN tag t ON t.id = dt.tag_id WHERE lr.user_id = #{userId} AND lr.source_type = 'DISH' AND lr.result_action IN ('ACCEPT', 'FAVORITE') AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' ) signals GROUP BY tag_id, tag_name ORDER BY weight DESC, tag_id ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT category_id AS id, category_name AS name, SUM(signal_weight) AS weight FROM ( SELECT d.category_id, cg.name AS category_name, 5.0 AS signal_weight FROM favorite f INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = f.target_id LEFT JOIN category cg ON cg.id = d.category_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'DISH' AND d.category_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT d.category_id, cg.name AS category_name, 3.0 AS signal_weight FROM eat_list el INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = el.dish_id LEFT JOIN category cg ON cg.id = d.category_id WHERE el.user_id = #{userId} AND el.status IN ('WANT_TO_EAT', 'EATEN') AND d.category_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT d.category_id, cg.name AS category_name, 4.0 AS signal_weight FROM review r INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = r.dish_id LEFT JOIN category cg ON cg.id = d.category_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'VISIBLE' AND r.overall_score >= 4.00 AND d.category_id IS NOT NULL ) signals GROUP BY category_id, category_name ORDER BY weight DESC, category_id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT canteen_id AS id, canteen_name AS name, SUM(signal_weight) AS weight FROM ( SELECT d.canteen_id, c.name AS canteen_name, 5.0 AS signal_weight FROM favorite f INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = f.target_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'DISH' UNION ALL SELECT d.canteen_id, c.name AS canteen_name, 3.0 AS signal_weight FROM eat_list el INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = el.dish_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id WHERE el.user_id = #{userId} AND el.status IN ('WANT_TO_EAT', 'EATEN') UNION ALL SELECT d.canteen_id, c.name AS canteen_name, 4.0 AS signal_weight FROM review r INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = r.dish_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'VISIBLE' AND r.overall_score >= 4.00 ) signals GROUP BY canteen_id, canteen_name ORDER BY weight DESC, canteen_id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT AVG(price) FROM ( SELECT d.price FROM favorite f INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = f.target_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'DISH' UNION ALL SELECT d.price FROM eat_list el INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = el.dish_id WHERE el.user_id = #{userId} AND el.status IN ('WANT_TO_EAT', 'EATEN') UNION ALL SELECT d.price FROM review r INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = r.dish_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'VISIBLE' AND r.overall_score >= 4.00 ) prices
SELECT d.name FROM favorite f INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = f.target_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'DISH' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT d.name FROM eat_list el INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = el.dish_id WHERE el.user_id = #{userId} AND el.status = 'EATEN' ORDER BY COALESCE(el.eaten_at, el.updated_at, el.created_at) DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT d.name FROM review r INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = r.dish_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'VISIBLE' AND r.overall_score >= 4.00 ORDER BY r.overall_score DESC, r.created_at DESC LIMIT 20
ORDER BY (d.favorite_count * 3 + d.review_count * 2 + d.view_count) DESC, d.average_score DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
